decisions.statutory_basis: Maharashtra (Urban Areas) Protection of Trees Act 1975, s.7 — compensation is trees planted in number equal to the AGE of the tree felled. Age is estimated from girth here; the census has no age column.

decisions.reason: Spathodea campanulata at 46 cm is a confirmed non-native species obstructing the footprint. decisions.statutory_basis: Maharashtra (Urban Areas) Protection of Trees Act 1975, s.7 — compensation is trees planted in number equal to the AGE of the tree felled. Age is estimated from girth here; the census has no age column.
